data.description: Private Beach Access | Sophisticated Waterfront Lifestyle
data.long_description:
Developed by Damac Properties, Bay 2 by Cavalli is a premium waterfront tower
located in Dubai Harbour overlooking the Arabian Gulf. The building features a
well-planned structure with multiple podium levels and 49 residential floors
offering luxury apartments and exclusive larger residences. High-end interiors
by Cavalli, premium finishes, and modern appliances define the living spaces.
Amenities include a private beach, spa, gym, pools, water maze, dining venues,
and leisure areas. Residents enjoy excellent connectivity to major Dubai
landmarks and transport hubs.
